articles.title: Michael Mann Seeks to Reclaim Rights to Original ‘Heat’ Screenplay
articles.content: Michael Mann , who is set to begin shooting the long-awaited “ Heat 2 ” in January, is in a legal dispute with New Regency as he seeks to reclaim the copyright to his screenplay for the original film. New Regency produced “Heat,” released in 1995. The company filed a lawsuit on Friday arguing that it still owns the copyright to the original screenplay. Earlier this year, Mann’s lawyers sent termination notices invoking the right to reclaim the copyright. New Regency argues that the screenplay was a “work made for hire,” and is thus ineligible for copyright termination. articles.summary: The star has found her next vehicle after the coming "Ocean's Eleven" prequel from Bradley Cooper.
articles.content: Margot Robbie has been tapped to star in “ The Week of Pain ,” the next feature from writer-director Kristoffer Borgli , IndieWire has confirmed. The project marks another starry vehicle for Borgli to follow up his grim romantic comedy “ The Drama ,” which rode Zendaya and Robert Pattinson’s marquee draw to a $134 million gross at the global box office for A24 . As with “The Drama,” the distributor will finance and produce “The Week of Pain” in a re-team with Ari Aster and Lars Knudsen’s Square Peg production banner. Robbie’s label LuckyChap Entertainment is also on board, along with Dilemma Films. Plot details remain undisclosed for “The Week of Pain,” though given the title and Borgli’s penchant for punishment it seems likely that Robbie’s character will be put through some of wringer. Along with “The Drama,” Borgli also wrote and directed the surreal Nicolas Cage comedy “Dream Scenario” at A24 and Square Peg back in 2023. “Dream Scenario” introduced Borgli’s unique brand of filmmaking to many American audiences, though he was already a distinct indie film voice thanks to prior features like the energy drink mockmentary “DRIB” and the brutal portrait of narcissism that was “Sick of Myself.” And after working with Zendaya, Pattinson, and now Robbie, he has become one of Hollywood’s go-to filmmakers for A-listers looking to stretch their acting chops with a singularly bizarre role. articles.summary: Olivia Isaacs' documentary on the (very) recently convicted and imprisoned rapist has been in the works for a while, but its fast-tracked release date seems designed to piggyback on the news, not offer any fresh insights.
articles.content: The term that comes to mind most is “ambulance-chasing.” Earlier this week, just one week after Russell Brand was convicted of rape and sexual assault and two days after he was sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison for his crimes, word spread that Netflix was prepping a documentary on the comedian-turned-criminal . Olivia Isaacs’ documentary has been in the works for a while. Deadline’s initial story on the project even noted that it “was referenced during the trial” and that while “giving evidence at London’s Southwark Crown Court, Mark Pinheiro, a former friend of Brand, said he had been approached by a producer about the Netflix show.” Related Stories David O. Russell’s ‘Madden’ Biopic Is Out Next Week — Does Anybody Know or Care? How essential, after all, could this be? And what could it tell us about Brand’s actual trial, sentencing, and conviction? Turns out, not much. articles.title: David O. Russell’s ‘Madden’ Biopic Is Out Next Week — Does Anybody Know or Care?
articles.summary: Amazon MGM Studios' release strategy for the five-time Oscar nominee's forthcoming "Madden," starring Nicolas Cage in a fat suit and hairpiece, suggests a classic case of bag-and-tag.
articles.content: Once upon a time, a new David O. Russell movie would be a must-see cinematic event. The writer/director earned three consecutive Best Picture Oscar nominations with “The Fighter,” “Silver Linings Playbook,” and “American Hustle,” all of which scored at the box office and are roundly regarded as generational classics of their era and even holiday fare. But did you know Russell has a new movie opening next week from Amazon MGM Studios? That would be “ Madden ,” his biopic starring a physically distended and hair-pieced Nicolas Cage as the iconic NFL commentator. When I told an IndieWire colleague about this story, they had heard of “ Madden ” the movie, yes, but had no idea that Russell directed it. Doesn’t bode well. Reports have claimed the sports biopic carries a $75 million budget, making it one of the “Spanking the Monkey” director’s most expensive movies next to the critically flayed COVID release “Amsterdam,” which, not adjusted for inflation, cost a reported $80 million and earned a paltry $14 million domestically. That’s a movie that entirely vaporized from the cultural imagination — though you may recall a much-memed excerpt of a blink-and-you’ll-miss-her Taylor Swift being thrown under a car to her doom. Founded by Jay Boyer and led by director of casting Amanda Lenker Doyle, CSA, the app has actors film original scenes on their phone and then receive feedback from professional casting directors. Boyer began working on the app a decade ago and started offering early access in November 2020 (with paid access starting the following year). Dauberman’s first-look deal will run through Coin Operated, the production company he founded in 2020, which is run by president Mia Maniscalco. The deal goes into effect next week. “I’m thrilled to be working with these two powerhouses,” said Dauberman in a statement. “It’s been great to watch Jason make films that connect so viscerally with not just me, but fans all over the world. On top of that, I am thrilled to be reuniting with James, who has always been such a strong supporter and huge influence on my work. Together, Blumhouse Atomic brings a unique combination of collaboration, inventiveness and engagement to the creative process. Under their partnership, I couldn’t be more excited to continue our history and make more projects together.” Related Stories Movies BlumFest Haunts New York Comic Con 2026: All the Highlights From Blumhouse Atomic Monster Movies LaKeith Stanfield, Ben Mendelsohn to Star in 'Molepeople' for Atomic Monster, Paramount Primal (Exclusive) The first look grows from Dauberman and Blumhouse Atomic’s previous collaborations. In June, Dauberman was hired to pen the script for the third installment of Five Nights at Freddy’s, Blumhouse Atomic and Universal’s adaptation of the hit video-game horror series. Dauberman also comes into the deal with a strong relationship with Wan, the filmmaker who originated The Conjuring Universe, which Dauberman became a key part of. articles.title: Elizabeth Holmes’ Husband Billy Evans Claims He Didn’t Consent to ‘You Can See Everything’ Nude Shower Scene
articles.summary: Evans says that he asked A24 and co-director Nathan Fielder to "pixelate" his full frontal shot after he heard the scene made it into the doc but they "refused to do so."
articles.content: Billy Evans claims that he “did not give consent” to his fully nude scene in the shower in Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim ‘s Elizabeth Holmes documentary You Can See Everything . In a preview clip from Holmes’ husband’s interview on CBS Sunday Morning with Matt Gutman, the host asked him, “Did you know you were doing the full monty? Did you give permission for that? There seems to be some discrepancy.” “I would say that our recollections are pretty different on that. I did not give consent to do that,” Evans replied. “Now, did I know they were filming me in the shower? Yes. But we would film 16 hours a day, like all sorts of things were filmed with assurances made. I was just as surprised as the rest of the country to have my whole body on camera for the world to see.” Related Stories Movies Margot Robbie to Star in A24's 'The Week of Pain' From 'The Drama' Filmmaker Kristoffer Borgli Movies Amanda Seyfried Eager to Campaign for 'You Can See Everything' as Awards Eligibility Comes Into Focus (Exclusive) Evans said that it has “been an awkward experience and having your kids’ teachers see that, it’s really uncomfortable.” He added, “ I’m not proud of it. I didn’t want it. It’s been weird seeing the commentary about, ‘Oh, he’s just showing the world.’ I’m a confident guy. I am not that confident.” Evans even alleged that he asked A24 and Fielder to “pixelate” his full frontal shot after he heard the scene made it into the doc from people who had screened it before it released, but they “refused to do so.” He explained, “I communicated with them before the film came out. Both through lawyers and through myself. I was like, ‘Can you pixelate this? Like, is there anything you can do?’ Because I had heard rumors from people who’d seen the film in the early screenings. articles.title: Aaron Pierre Starrer ‘Fairytale in New York’ Lands at Netflix
articles.summary: The Lionsgate action thriller from director Jalmari Helander centers on a vengeful cab driver on a Christmas Eve rampage in the Big Apple.
articles.content: Netflix has picked up the action-thriller Fairytale in New York , starring Lanterns actor Aaron Pierre and directed by Jalmari Helander, from Lionsgate with a winning competitive bid. The feature from the Sisu helmer is set on Christmas Eve in New York City when an unassuming cabbie goes on a relentless night of vengeance after his estranged son’s priceless gift is stolen. Helander will direct from an original spec script from writers Rory Haines and Sohrab Noshirvani ( John Rambo ). Pierre starred as John Stewart in the HBO and DC Studios live action series Lanterns and also appeared in Rachel Morrison’s Love of Your Life and had a voice role in Sony Pictures Animation’s sports comedy Goat. Related Stories Next Big Thing Gabby Windey Conquered Reality TV. Now She's Determined to Be Your New Favorite Actress TV 'Virgin River' Renewed for Netflix-Record Ninth Season Lionsgate earlier produced War Machine for Netflix and Pierre had a breakout role in another Netflix movie, Jeremy Saulnier’s Rebel Ridge. Lionsgate Motion Picture Group president Erin Westerman welcomed continuing a successful creative run with Netflix and Helander. “Coming off the extraordinary success of War Machine , we couldn’t be more excited to be making another film with our friends at Netflix. And this marks our third collaboration with Jalmari. He’s an exceptional filmmaker with a distinctive ability to deliver visceral, memorable action while never losing sight of character and emotion. That makes him a perfect match for Aaron Pierre, who has all the makings of a major movie star — commanding screen presence, undeniable charisma and the ability to bring real depth and emotion to his performances. We think this is going to be a very special film,” Westerman said in a statement. Fairytale in New York will be produced by Beau Flynn for FlynnPictureCo, and Kevin King Templeton for Templeton Media. Scott Sheldon, Rory Haines and Sohrab Noshirvani are executive producing. articles.title: Margot Robbie to Star in A24’s ‘The Week of Pain’ From ‘The Drama’ Filmmaker Kristoffer Borgli
articles.summary: The project will mark the actress' first time starring in a film for the studio.
articles.content: Margot Robbie is set to star in A24 and Square Peg’s The Week of Pain , The Hollywood Reporter has confirmed. Kristoffer Borgli , the writer-director of The Drama , is on board to write and direct the film. A24 is financing and producing the film, with Lars Knudsen and Ari Aster’s Square Peg producing alongside Dilemma Films and Robbie’s LuckyChap. The project will reunite Borgli with the studio and Square Peg following the success of The Drama , a romantic dark comedy starring Zendaya and Robert Pattinson. Released by A24 in April, the film became one of the studio’s highest-grossing movies globally, earning $134 million at the worldwide box office. Borgli also wrote and directed 2023’s Dream Scenario , starring Nicolas Cage, for A24. Related Stories Movies Amanda Seyfried Eager to Campaign for 'You Can See Everything' as Awards Eligibility Comes Into Focus (Exclusive) Movies Amanda Seyfried Feared 'You Can See Everything' Could "Destroy" Her Career, Says Her Opinion of Billy Evans "Only Got Worse" Most recently, Robbie starred in the literary romance Wuthering Heights , released Feb. 13, alongside Jacob Elordi, with the two playing Cathy and Heathcliff, respectively. The Warner Bros. film, based on Emily Brontë’s novel of the same name, grossed $241.8 million worldwide. Plot details for The Week of Pain are being kept under wraps, but the project will mark the Barbie star’s first time starring in an A24 film. The two-time Oscar-nominated actress is currently wrapping production on her Ocean’s prequel, in which she co-stars with Bradley Cooper, who also directs. Monica Barbaro, George MacKay, Vicky Krieps, Josh Gad, Wagner Moura, Omar Sy, Jack Holden and Lauren Ridloff are among the cast . Robbie is repped by Entertainment 360, CAA, Narrative, Aran Michael Management and attorney Jeff Bernstein. Borgli is represented by UTA.

articles.title: When Kevin Feige Got Off to a Less-Than-Incredible Start at Marvel
articles.summary: The future Marvel mastermind shepherded Ang Lee’s ‘Hulk,’ starring Edward Norton, to the big screen.
articles.content: The success that Marvel Studios honcho Kevin Feige has achieved over the two-plus decades since landing on The Hollywood Reporter ‘s Next Gen list in 2003 would likely make any producer green with envy. Boston-born and New Jersey-raised, Feige was rejected from USC film school five times before finally getting accepted. He later landed an unpaid internship with Superman director Richard Donner and his wife, producer Lauren Shuler Donner. Feige continued working as an assistant for Shuler Donner, leading him to earn an associate producer credit for Fox’s 2000 release X-Men . Feige’s passion for the company impressed Marvel Studios founder Avi Arad, who hired him to oversee other studios’ use of Marvel superheroes. Feige would later tell THR that, during his time as a Marvel Studios producer until he was named president of production in 2006, he would learn about the various productions and was “thinking always, ‘One day, if I’m in a position of power, I’ll do things this way; I’m going to not do things like that.’ ” Related Stories TV 'VisionQuest' Creator Terry Matalas Tells All About That Supersized Finale and Post-Credits Surprise General News "You Shall Not Pass": Gandalf, Black Panther and Deadpool Take to the Streets of France At the time of his Next Gen selection in fall 2003, Feige was executive vp at Marvel Studios. He had also just executive produced Ang Lee’s Hulk , the Universal summer release that starred Eric Bana as physicist Bruce Banner, who transforms into his green-skinned alter ego when angered. Although THR ‘s review praised the film for its “visual energy, genuine artistry and compelling human emotions,” it collected a modest $245 million globally against a $137 million budget. Three years later, Marvel Studios bought back the rights to the Hulk and released 2008’s Edward Norton-led movie The Incredible Hulk . articles.title: Darth Vader’s Lightsaber Sets ‘Star Wars’ Auction Record Selling for Nearly $5 Million
articles.summary: The prop has easily exceeded a previous record set by Luke Skywalker's lightsaber.
articles.content: The Dark Side really is more seductive, more powerful — judging by this latest auction sale, at least. Darth Vader’s iconic lightsaber from 1980’s Star Wars : The Empire Strikes Back has set a record for the highest-selling Star Wars prop ever. The lightsaber sold for a whopping $4,875,000 at Heritage Auctions on Nov. 12, the highest price paid for any collectible item from the franchise (inflation, it seems, has even reached a galaxy far, far away). Vader’s weapon was used in the Cloud City confrontation in The Empire Strikes Back and also appeared in 1983’s Return of the Jedi . The lightsaber surpassed by $1 million the previous overall Star Wars record of $3,875,000 for Tom Jung’s original half-sheet key poster painting for Star Wars: Episode IV – A New Hope . It also bested a $3,750,000 sale for Luke Skywalker’s lightsaber and severed hand effects rig back in July. Some other high-value sales over the years have included Red Leader’s X-wing fighter miniature going for $3.1 million in 2023, a full-size R2-D2 droid going for $2.8 million and Han Solo’s blaster from A New Hope fetching around $1 million.

articles.summary: “It was very hard to have to pivot from a story we desperately wanted to tell to a story that was more personal and difficult,” director Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi told The Hollywood Reporter at the SCAD Savannah Film Festival.
articles.content: Over their career, directors Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi and Jimmy Chin have made films about people physically and spiritually pushing themselves to the limit, ascending the mountains of Free Solo and Meru and swimming Nyad ’s Straits of Florida. Yet when it came to making their next movie, the documentary Everest: The Other Side , the Oscar-winning pair confronted not only the cost and risks of pursuing these kinds of feats but also the nature of depicting them — which is to say, their roles as filmmakers. articles.title: Dawn Greenhalgh, Voice of the Elephant Queen Celeste in ‘Babar’ Cartoons, Dies at 93
articles.summary: The stage veteran and mother of ‘Anne of Green Gables’ star Megan Follows also appeared in films for David Cronenberg and Sophia Coppola.
articles.content: Dawn Greenhalgh, the Canadian actress who provided the voice of the spirited Queen Celeste for two animated series that centered on the beloved children’s character Babar the elephant, has died. She was 93. Survivors include her youngest daughter, actress Megan Follows, who starred as Anne Shirley in three Anne of Green Gables miniseries and as Catherine, Queen of France on the 2013-17 CW series Reign . Two Estranged Irish Brothers Facing Trauma. Greenhalgh started out on the stage, where she was a founding castmember of the renowned Stratford Festival in Stratford, Ontario. Later, she studied with Uta Hagen, Herbert Berghof and Mira Rostova in New York and appeared in theaters from Manhattan to the West End. On the big screen, she portrayed the agent who reps actress Havana Segrand (Julianne Moore) in David Cronenberg’s Maps to the Stars (2014) after working in such other films as Sofia Coppola’s The Virgin Suicides (1999), Avenging Angelo (2002) and Welcome to Mooseport (2004). Greenhalgh voiced Celeste over five seasons (1989-91) on Babar , the CBC-Nelvana series based on the books by French writer-illustrator Jean de Brunhoff (her husband the king was played by Gordon Pinsent ). The show also aired on HBO in the U.S. and in more than 150 other countries. She and then Pinsent returned in 2010-11 with the computer-animated sequel Babar and the Adventures of Badou . Hazel Dawn Greenhalgh was born to British parents, Elizabeth and Laurence, on Sept. 25, 1933, in Shanghai, China. She and her family were held in a prisoner of war camp during the Japanese occupation of the city. “It was there she discovered that in the midst of such abject misery, her love of music, theater and dance could offer happiness, purpose and temporary respite, both to herself and to her audience,” her family noted. articles.title: ‘Pluribus’ Ups Samba Schutte to Series Regular in Season 2
articles.summary: The actor appeared in two episodes of the Apple TV show's first season.
articles.content: A key guest star from season one of Pluribus is getting a bigger role in season two. Samba Schutte , who appeared in two episodes of the Emmy-winning Apple TV series’ first season, will be a series regular in the coming season. Pluribus is in production on season two, though Apple TV has yet to announce a premiere date. Schutte plays Mr. Diabaté in Pluribus , one of the handful of humans who — like lead character Carol Sturka (Rhea Seehorn) — have not had their consciousness subsumed to an extraterrestrial collective mind. Unlike Carol, Mr. Diabaté is very much enjoying the new status quo on Earth, living in luxury in a Las Vegas casino hotel and having his every whim catered to. Related Stories TV Meet the British Foodie Demystifying the Michelin Guide's Secrets TV Apple TV Renews 'Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars' for Season 3 Schutte earned a Saturn Award nomination for best guest star for his work in season one. He joins Seehorn, Karolina Wydra and Carlos-Manuel Vesga in the show’s regular cast. Season one of Pluribus won six Emmys, including lead actress honors for Seehorn and a writing win for creator Vince Gilligan. It also earned a Peabody Award. Sony Pictures TV, Gilligan’s long-time home, produces the series. Gilligan executive produces with Gordon Smith, Alison Tatlock, Diane Mercer, Jeff Frost, Jenn Carroll and Trina Siopy. Schutte’s credits also include HBO Max’s Our Flag Means Death , NBC’s Sunnyside and voice work on Jurassic World: Chaos Theory , several Call of Duty: Black Ops games and Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order , among others. He was also a writer and correspondent on the Dutch version of The Daily Show . He is repped by Innovative Artists and Established Artists.

articles.title: Savannah Guthrie Extends ‘Today’ Show Deal
articles.content: Savannah Guthrie has extended her contract with NBC News , The Hollywood Reporter has confirmed. Guthrie’s contract was set to expire at the end of the year. Guthrie, the popular co-anchor of NBC’s Today show, has been the news as much as she’s reported the news this year. In the early morning hours of Feb. 1, 2026, Guthrie’s mom Nancy Guthrie was kidnapped from her Tucson, Arizona home. Nancy Guthrie is presumed dead though her remains have never been found. Nancy was 84 years old and in poor health. She did not have her necessary medication with her. Related Stories TV The Other Midterms Flip: Broadcast Networks, Led by NBC, Dominated Election Night Coverage TV Carson Daly Named Co-Anchor of NBC's 'Saturday Today' On Feb. 10, doorbell footage of a masked man approaching her home on the night of her disappearance was made public. No suspect was ever identified. A pair of notes from the purported kidnapper(s) were sent to local news outlets. The first demanded Bitcoin for Nancy’s safe return; the second note did not demand money but stated that Nancy died shortly after her abduction. The second note reads, in full: “Guthrie Family, We did not fully grasp the seriousness of her physical condition. We never intended to hurt her, that was not our intention. She perished shortly after she was taken. We believe it was heart related. She is buried in nature now. Nothing you could have done could have changed the outcome. We want your family to know this and hope you can all find peace. We are truly sorry.” Savannah Guthrie returned to work at the NBC morning show in April. Craig Melvin is her Today show co-anchor. Guthrie is set to co-host the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade with her usual collaborators Hoda Kotb and Al Roker. This Thanksgiving marks the 100th anniversary of the procession. The Macy’s march actually began in 1924, but it took a three-year hiatus during World War II.

articles.title: Streaming Ratings: ‘From’ Dominates an Otherwise Quiet Halloween Week
articles.summary: The sci-fi/horror series is the only title to draw more than a billion minutes of watch time.
articles.content: The last week of October was a relatively quiet one on Nielsen’s streaming charts, with one big exception. From , the MGM+ show that was added to Netflix’s library on Oct. 19, spent its second straight week as the No. 1 overall title. The series drew 2.04 billion minutes of watch time, up 24 percent week to week . From also surpassed the mark it set a week earlier for the most viewing minutes for an acquired series this year. Beyond From , however, there weren’t a lot of highlights. No other series or movie cracked the billion-minute mark. The top 10 overall titles combined for 9.03 billion minutes of viewing, down from 9.22 billion the previous week. Netflix’s Nobody Wants This (847 million minutes) led the original series top 10. The comedy was up about 17 percent week to week but once again trailed its performance from a year ago. In the two weeks after season three’s Oct. 22 premiere, Nobody Wants This has totaled 1.57 billion viewing minutes, off about 14 percent from 1.83 billion minutes for the same time frame after season two’s debut last year. Love Is Blind (796 million minutes), VisionQuest (548 million) and Tulsa King (501 million) all posted small week to week improvements. Netflix’s Lupin (579 million) had the week’s best premiere, and the short docuseries The One About Matthew Perry had 541 million minutes of viewing. Hocus Pocus rose to the top of the movie rankings during Halloween week, scoring 405 million minutes of viewing on Disney+. The Nightmare Before Christmas, Coraline, Coco and Hocus Pocus 2 also made the top 10. Nielsen’s streaming ratings cover viewing on TV sets only and don’t include minutes watched on computers or mobile devices. The ratings only measure U.S. audiences. articles.title: Christian Cousins, Young Actor in ‘Knots Landing’ and ‘Kindergarten Cop,’ Dies at 43
articles.summary: He and his identical twin, Joseph, shared roles as Bobby Ewing on the CBS show and as Penelope Ann Miller’s son in the Arnold Schwarzenegger movie.
articles.content: Christian Cousins, who with his identical twin brother shared roles as youngsters on the CBS primetime soap Knots Landing and in the Arnold Schwarzenegger film Kindergarten Cop , has died. He was 43. Cousins died Oct. 20 after a battle with liver disease, his half-brother Jonas Roeser announced on Instagram. “He was a character, full of passion and energy, with big stories and even bigger dreams,” he wrote. Christian and twin brother Joseph were not yet 4 when they first appeared on Knots Landing as Bobby Ewing during the show’s ninth season in 1987, and they wound up on 57 episodes through 1992. articles.title: ABC Reveals NFL Quarterback as Next Star of ‘The Bachelor’
articles.summary: Sam Hartman will lead the next season in March after a hiatus for the franchise.
articles.content: ABC made the announcement on Good Morning America on Friday morning, surprising fans of the long-running reality dating series after a hiatus for the franchise. “I’m excited but also very nervous,” Hartman said in his first interview. “I have a tough time holding conversation with one girl — 30 is going to be pretty tough.” The 27-year-old pro athlete is “changing the game” and “ready to find his forever teammate,” promised ABC in the announcement. His 30th season of the flagship begins with the March 21 premiere (8-10 p.m. on ABC, streaming next day on Hulu and on Disney+ for bundle subscribers). Related Stories TV 'Love Trapped' Podcast Coming to TV as Peacock Docuseries 'Dancing' Diaries After 'DWTS' Season 35, Mark Ballas Would Love His Wife BC Jean to Be His Next Celebrity Partner The Bachelor last wrapped its 29th season, starring Grant Ellis, on March 24, 2025. The overall franchise took an extended break following that fall’s Bachelor in Paradise , however, due to the last-minute cancellation of Taylor Frankie Paul ‘s 22nd season of The Bachelorette , which had been planned to premiere in March 2026 but was pulled from the schedule after videos resurfaced of an alleged domestic incident. Hartman’s casting marks the fifth athlete to lead The Bachelor (Mel Owens also starred on The Golden Bachelor ), but the first to be a current athlete while starring on the dating show. articles.content: Michael John Roberts, the Canadian director, producer and animator with credits including TripTank , BoJack Horseman and Dallas & Robo , has died. He was 48. Roberts died peacefully at his home in Los Angeles on Wednesday surrounded by his family after a brief battle with glioblastoma. Roberts, who specialized in animated comedy for adults, helmed 2017 episodes of Netflix’s F Is for Family , starring Bill Burr, and served as the supervising director on the first season of the TBS animated comedy-drama Final Space in 2018. In 2015, he found time to direct title sequences and episodes of Netflix’s acclaimed BoJack Horseman , starring Will Arnett and Aaron Paul. Roberts also created the eight-episode buddy comedy Dallas & Robo , which starred John Cena and Kat Dennings and premiered on YouTube Red in 2018. Always partial to science fiction, he called it “ Smokey and the Bandit in space.” TripTank , BoJack Horseman , Dallas & Robo and Final Space all emanated from the animation studio and production company ShadowMachine. articles.content: The ratings renaissance for Dancing With the Stars has continued throughout this season, and it reached a high with Tuesday’s episode. The episode, which featured the contestants and their pro partners dancing to Grammy-winning and -nominated songs — and live performances from Sheryl Crow, Maren Morris and Brandy and Monica — averaged 7.39 million viewers on ABC and Disney+ in Nielsen’s final same-day ratings. articles.title: Jason Benetti Will Replace Dan Hicks on Notre Dame Play-by-Play Saturday Following Sudden Passing (Exclusive)

articles.content: Following the sudden passing of Dan Hicks , Jason Benetti will take the reins this weekend as play-by-play guy for NBC Sports’ Notre Dame vs. Boston College game. Just yesterday, Hicks was announced as the game’s play-by-play voice. Jason Garrett is the booth’s analyst and Caroline Pineda has sideline-reporting duties. Reggie Smith is rules analyst. BC will visit South Bend, Indiana at 3:30 p.m. ET on Saturday, Nov. 14; the game will air on NBC and stream live on Peacock . Live coverage begins with College Countdown at 3 p.m. ET on the same platforms. Boston College is unranked, Notre Dame is the number five team in the country. The Fighting Irish have not lost a game at home this season (4-0) and are 8-1 overall. Last week, Notre Dame defeated the number one team in the nation, the Miami Hurricanes, 31-24. Boston College lost to Florida State by the same score. Hicks died on Wednesday, and no cause of death is available. He was 64. Hicks’ wife, Hannah Storm, in an X tweet on Thursday wrote: “Our family is heartbroken by the sudden and unexpected passing of Dan following an acute illness. He was a devoted husband of over 30 years, loving father to our three daughters, and cherished friend to so many. His loss is immeasurable.” In addition to Notre Dame games, Hicks worked 16 Olympics and called lots of golf. NBC Sports confirmed to The Hollywood Reporter the passing of Hicks, and Versant CEO Mark Lazarus added in a statement: “I am heartbroken by the sudden loss of our friend Dan Hicks. For decades, I had the privilege of working alongside Dan, but our friendship extended far beyond NBC Sports. Dan was one of the very best at what he did, but what I will remember most is the person he was: a loyal friend and a devoted husband and father. My family and I are thinking of Hannah, their children and the entire Hicks family. We will miss him.”

According to Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin, some of those concerns may be overblown. “We were wanting to assure all the American people, this isn’t a safety to the American people or another 9/11,” he said. “I think that’s what a lot of people are trying to make the comparison to, and that is not the case.” Mullin addressed a crowd of reporters gathered outside the White House on Friday afternoon to speak to the FAA’s actions, which will delay flights for citizens across the country for an indefinite amount of time. Though the secretary assured that “there is no reason for the public to be afraid or scared for your loved ones,” he couldn’t explain what exactly caused the “telecommunication outage.” “Do we know what has caused it yet? No, we’re going to go through it. But I’m not going to make assumptions,” Mullin said. “As I’ve said multiple times, it’s very difficult to make assumptions. We want to always deal with facts, and we’re going to deal with facts, and as we get them, we’ll roll them out to you guys.” Mullin: There's no reason for the public to be afraid or scared for your loved ones. No. pic.twitter.com/HteUPUWl7Y Mullin reiterated multiple times during his appearance that the telecommunication outage is not a version of terror comparable to 9/11, saying “that’s a road I won’t go down.”

articles.content: With Cannes entry “Bitter Christmas,” Oscar-winning Spanish auteur Pedro Almodóvar (“Talk to Her”) is back. My bet: he will not shoot another film in English and will stick to making movies in his native language. articles.summary: Her Jessica Chastain-starring Netflix drama "Heartland" is the latest entry in Feste's distinct canon. It's a space where, she tells IndieWire, women aren't "unlikable," they're just more nuanced, more complicated, and way more able to get shit done.
articles.content: Shana Feste knows her filmography might be a bit tough to pin down. Some directors like to stick to a certain genre . Not Feste. Some only like to work with certain stars. Not Feste. Others enter a franchise and never look back. Not Feste. But over the course of nearly two decades behind the camera, Feste has carved out a particular sweet spot, regardless of the genre or the cast or the wider world her stories fit inside: She likes complicated women. Not unlikable women, but messy women, contradictory women, women who get things done their own way. It’s a signature unto itself. “My filmmaking, my history, people have not really known what to do with me. I’m making a comedy, I’m making a horror film , I’m making a genre thriller,” Feste told IndieWire during a recent interview. “But I do find that they’re all starting to build into each other, especially the trajectory from ‘Country Strong’ to ‘Run Sweetheart Run’ to ‘ Heartland .’ I’ve always been drawn to women who don’t behave correctly. I’ve always been interested in women who don’t grieve correctly, who mother incorrectly, who love incorrectly. articles.title: ’12 12 12′ Review: Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan’s Ticking-Clock Heist Thriller Runs on Broken Time
articles.summary: An FBI agent out for revenge. A thief planning one last score. You know the story, but in Dudi Appleton and Jim Keeble's convoluted Apple series, you can watch it unfold across three non-chronological timelines.
articles.content: Every episode of “12 12 12” opens with the same explanation of its title: Citing the fictitious law enforcement manual, “Principles of Crime, FBI Research Center, 4th Edition,” Anthony Mackie explains, “A high asset robbery, professionally conceived, is 12 months in planning, 12 hours in execution. A bank robber who’s not caught within 12 days is not caught at all.” Then the screen splits horizontally to reveal images from the 12 months of preparation, the 12 hours of execution, and the 12 days when thief extraordinaire Paul Galvin ( Jamie Dornan ) does his best to elude Mackie’s obsessed FBI agent Jack Strickland. And then, we’re off to the races. Related Stories ‘The Good Daughter’ Review: Rose Byrne Sizzles in Peacock’s Brutal Trauma-Drama About Crime-Solving Sisters ‘American Doctor’ and ‘You Can See Everything’ Lead 2027 Cinema Eye Honors Film Nominations The heist genre, in theory, seems ripe for this kind of temporal manipulation. A game of wits between cops and criminals typically involves plenty of twists, many of which pull the rug out by flashing back to show where, when, and how it was placed so stealthily underfoot. Also working in “12 12 12’s” favor is the genre’s familiarity: There will be “getting the team together” montages, there will be unexpected hiccups in the days and hours during the robbery, there will be chest-thumping meetings between our confident cop and the equally confident con artist. Throw in the complex heist itself and the tense escape soon after, and there appear to be enough recognizable pieces that jumbling them up shouldn’t prove too confusing. And “12 12 12” isn’t confusing. It is, however, convoluted. Taking a serpentine route through well-trodden territory does more to undermine our enjoyment of an otherwise well-mounted chase than it does to liven things up. Heists are inherently exciting.
